This internal iPhone build adds Keystone QR signing for XBT Native SegWit watch-only accounts. Unified signing is the default.

Using a test account, open Wallet Details and select “Standard hardware signing (Keystone)”. Read the privacy notice. RedWallet checks coin separation before preparing a signing request and again before broadcast. Blockstream receives public funding transaction IDs. Both Blockstream and mempool.space see your IP address.

If you have a prepared test fixture, open Send and check that the recipient, amount and fee on the Keystone match the iPhone. Stop at the review screen. A missing proof should block the signing request with “Coin separation could not be verified.” Testing here requires no live payment.
